Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).

Root cause is pool exhaustion from `dep-4471`, which gives each request its own connection against a pool of 20. Window ran `02:14:18.972Z` to `03:59:27.974Z` and was still open at log end. 530 of 636 requests failed, 83%.

Two things flagged in the doc. `/health` passed all 180 checks while traffic burned. The log is `node-3 of 3`, so confirm the other two nodes.

Next: roll back `dep-4471`.
